## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] Builds on the platforms this change affects; tests added or updated and passing
- [ ] Public API / protocol changes are documented (and an ADR or RFC exists if architectural)
- [ ] No new third-party dependency, or it is listed in `third_party/dependencies.json` with its licence
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or unlicensed assets
- [ ] If AI-assisted: I reviewed the change myself and it was reviewed by someone other than its author
